title: bt-dht: decode version field
description:
Adds explicit decoding of the version field of BT-DHT packets, with
specific field types to allow searching on the client name and version
if they are known. The dict_entry node that previously showed the
version is kept in the tree for backwards compatibility (and because it
reduces amount of refactoring needed), but it is hidden to avoid UI
duplication. The hiding of the dict_entry node is done after the
proto_item_set_text call so the node appears the same as before in the
output tree with the exception of the hide attribute.

The supported clients are the ones I could reliably identify with
version decoding for libtorrent since it is so widespread. rTorrent and
Monotorrent also have enough public information available to decode
their version numbers, but for now they were skipped since they don't
appear much on the network.

In the wild the rough distribution of inbound packets seen by me is:
 * libtorrent 47%
 * XDHT 12%
 * uTorrent 4%
 * rTorrent 0.08%
 * Monotorrent 0.02%
 * Other clients 5%
 * No version field 32%

This is also meant as a conservative attempt at moving the bt-dht dissector in the direction of meaningful fields rather than the mostly syntax-oriented fields that are in use today. The PDML output changes can be seen here:
https://gitlab.com/zidel_/wireshark_tests/-/commit/c2b55a19e6da61e59506655dddb3605ca8092a44
